Messages.Author: Frederic Genest
Messages.Body:
Greetings all.

I'm sure I'll be sounding like a newbie but, please, believe me when I
said I've been playing the game since it came out. However, not much.
:-)

So, twice in a few weeks the question came with two different
playgroups, with two different answers to settle the matter. So I'd
like to have a professional opinion on that one.

Situation:
a) an Untapped minion Bum Rushed by another one
b) no block is made, either from the target or another minion.

Q) does the target minion become tapped?

I think not, as the target was untapped, didn't block, the card text
doesn't say the target becomes tapped, and "being tapped or untapped
doesn't matter for combat".

Thanks for settling this "dispute".

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <703899b7.01062...@posting.google.com>, Frederic
Genest <gen...@iname.com> writes

>Situation:
>a) an Untapped minion Bum Rushed by another one
>b) no block is made, either from the target or another minion.
>
>Q) does the target minion become tapped?

A vampire taps from:

1) acting
2) blocking successfully
3) card text

This is none of those, so they aren't tapped.
